title: The Name Wall
text: A wall is covered in thousands of names, each crossed out in red. These were the faceless before they forgot, the old folk say. Near the bottom, fresh and uncrossed, a Scion's name is written in your own handwriting.

options.label: The named Scion crosses out their own name, so the city takes them for one of its own.

outcomes.text: The city takes them in and lets you all pass, though they feel it take something from them.
Their face goes numb for a day, and their mouth will not shape words.

options.label: Scrub the name off the wall; it was not yours to write.

outcomes.text: As you watch, it comes back fainter in the same hand.

options.label: The wisest reads the other names, to learn who stood here before you.

outcomes.text: Some are names from the House's histories. Now you know how they ended.
